node.title: A=1 core-one exceptional-trace allocation
node.statement: Every official active core has the full first complement QV_a+P_XW_a=P. If D_*=1 and the exceptional trace is zero, the Z_W=E_Z allocation contradicts the positive gcd of Q(gamma_0;X) and P_X; necessarily E_Z divides B, every domain trace is active, and Q(gamma_0;X) is a squarefree degree-(r-1) divisor of G_X. Thus the active branch consists of exactly the three systems in (ETA4): no exceptional factor, active exceptional trace, or zero exceptional trace with all domain traces active.
